SELECT 
    p.productid AS "产品ID",
    p.name AS "名称",
    pi.locationid AS "库位ID",
    pi.quantity AS "数量",
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.locationid ORDER BY pi.quantity DESC) AS "排名"
FROM production.productinventory pi
INNER JOIN production.product p ON pi.productid = p.productid
WHERE pi.locationid BETWEEN 3 AND 4
ORDER BY pi.locationid, pi.quantity DESC
